title: The Wii U network takes shape
body: The Wii U network is under construction on honest foundations. Our adapter now handles registration, sign-in, the NEX token exchange and identity checks, and the friends server passes end-to-end tests against a live account core and adapter. It is built as a clean reimplementation over the OpenPak account core, so your identity matches the website and every other console. No Wii U has connected yet — hardware testing is the next milestone, and it is a close one.
footer: OpenPak — open network services for your console.
